purpose: Validate that character perceptions and the eight-frame perspective plan are causally justified, information-safe, physically coherent, emotionally continuous and faithful to one canonical scene reality before visual generation.
core_principle: Perception may differ; reality may not.
hard_rules: A perception cannot assert an objective physical fact that contradicts canonical scene reality.
A character cannot perceive information unavailable through sensory access or a valid information event.
Future or later-scene information is a blocker unless explicitly authorized by the narrative mechanism.
Emotion may modify salience and interpretation but cannot serve as evidence of an unseen fact.
Observation and interpretation must remain distinguishable.
A character may misinterpret an observed fact, but the system must preserve the underlying fact.
Different character perceptions should differ for causal reasons, not arbitrary variation.
Blind spots must be plausible given attention, access and knowledge.
Perceived intention of another character must carry uncertainty unless directly established by dialogue/action.
Audience-only information must be explicitly marked and must not leak into character state.
The eight frames must preserve one canonical reality while providing meaningful perspective progression.
Identity and emotional continuity locks must remain intact.

rework_policy.principle: Fix the smallest causal layer that failed rather than rewriting the entire scene.

output_schema.rework_plan: smallest upstream gate capable of correction
output_schema.audit_trail: inputs, checks, timestamp and validation version

evidence: All three characters observe the same physical event: Ravana contains his power.
Ravana interprets the event through challenged pride and self-questioning.
Rama interprets the same event through controlled confirmation.
Hanuman interprets it through protective vigilance and trust in Rama.
No character receives Ravana's private motive as established fact.
F01-F08 maintain a single scene reality while changing controlled perspective.
